headings.usage: Use for all titles, module headers, and dashboard metric numbers. Do not use Inter for headings.

body.usage: Use for all clinical records, long form texts, tables, and standard UI elements. Excellent legibility for long text.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalist approach. Use shadow-sm for cards. For hover states, use shadow-md and a subtle -translate-y-[1px].
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-slate-200 on cards and tables. This ensures structural clarity without heavy visual noise.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Avoid glassmorphism. It feels cold for health apps. Use flat, warm, solid colors like the #FFFFFF or #F0F4F8. For input fields, use flat borders.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Hover states must have higher contrast. Buttons should transition to a darker shade of the primary color.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-md. High contrast. Primary buttons must be Deep Navy (#1E3A8A).
components.cards: Flat design with maximum 8px border radius (rounded-md). White background (#FFFFFF) with a 1px soft border.
components.tables: High density. Use IBM Plex Sans. Left align all text columns. Subtle row hover states (bg-slate-50).
components.forms: Inputs should have rounded-md, flat backgrounds, explicit focus rings using the primary Deep Navy color.
components.sidebar: Active state should be highlighted with the Primary Deep Navy color with a subtle background tint.
components.tabs: Override default Shadcn heights. Use clear underline or solid pill indicators for active states.
components.toasts: Use sonner for notifications (e.g., green for success, amber for warnings, red for deletions).

layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Summary cards col-span-1, Main chart col-span-3, Feed col-span-1 row-span-2. Tight gaps (gap-6).
layouts.patients_panel: List view (table) or Grid view (Bento cards). Generous internal padding (p-6) in cards.
layouts.clinical_records: Split view layout. Patient history on the left (1/3), Rich text editor for new evolution on the right (2/3). Maximum readability.
layouts.agenda: Visual calendar stretching full width. Use Shadcn calendar heavily customized for week/month views.

motion.transitions: Use specific properties. transition-colors duration-200 for buttons. transition-transform duration-200 for hover lifts.
motion.page_load: Subtle fade and slide up (framer-motion) for dashboard widgets. staggerChildren for lists.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG adherence. Dark Slate Blue (#0F172A) on Ice Blue (#F8FAFC) provides excellent contrast for reading.
accessibility.focus: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 focus:ring-offset-2 on all interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='login-button').

images.description: Blue and teal flowing wave shapes. Use as the side panel image for the login screen to evoke calm and mental wellness.
Abstract wavy lines. Use with low opacity as a background for empty states (e.g., no patients yet).

media.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all icons. Ensure consistent stroke width (1.5px).

instructions_to_main_agent: You must build a hybrid fullstack medical SaaS application for Psychology Clinic Management.
Implement the UI entirely in Portuguese (Brasil) as requested.
Update index.css with the provided HSL variables for light mode. This app defaults to Light mode for medical clarity.
Use Manrope for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text. Import them in index.html or global css.
Build Shadcn components: Button, Input, Card, Table, Dialog, Dropdown Menu, Calendar, Textarea, Avatar, Tabs.
For the Clinical Records (Prontuários), use a layout with a large, highly legible textarea or rich text component (imutabilidade com versionamento oculto).
Ensure the Sidebar navigation uses the Primary Deep Navy color (#1E3A8A) for active states.
Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for any overlay or header.
Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, links, and forms.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Follow the specific font and layout instructions strictly.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but avoid glassmorphism for this medical app. Stick to flat, clean surfaces.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
